departure_arrival.title: Configure Stop Sensor
departure_arrival.description: Choose filters and update settings for this stop sensor.

data.line_filter: Line Filter (comma-separated; empty for all lines)
data.direction: Destination Filter (substring; empty for all destinations)
data.update_condition: Update Condition (template; render to 'true' to fetch)
data.max_departures_by_direction: Max Departures by Direction (e.g. 'söder:8, norr:8'; overrides mode limits above when set)
data.night_gap_end_bus: Bus dead zone start hour (0 = none)
data.night_gap_end_metro: Metro dead zone start hour (0 = none)
data.night_gap_end_train: Train dead zone start hour (0 = none)
data.night_gap_end_tram: Tram dead zone start hour (0 = none)
data.night_gap_end_boat: Boat dead zone start hour (0 = none)

data_description.transport_modes: Leave empty to show all modes.
data_description.time_window: Search ceiling in minutes ahead. Each API call covers 60 minutes; extra chunks are only fetched until departure limits are filled, an empty hour is reached, or max API chunks is hit. Monthly quota ≈ sensors × chunks × (2592000 / refresh_interval). At 60 or below, exactly one call is made per refresh and any night-service-gap setting is ignored (there's no room to skip ahead); set it higher than 60 if you want fetching to bridge a nightly gap and reach next-service departures.
data_description.refresh_interval: How often to fetch. Prefer ≥300s when using multi-chunk windows. Doubling the interval halves monthly API usage.
data_description.max_departures: Used as the overall cap when no per-mode overrides are set, and as the fallback for modes left at 0. Fetching stops early once these limits are filled.
data_description.max_departures_by_direction: Optional 'token:count, token:count' list, matched as case-insensitive substrings against each departure's destination (same rule as the Destination Filter). Each direction gets its own independent quota — e.g. 'söder:8, norr:8' guarantees 8 of each regardless of how the other direction is served. When set, this replaces the per-mode limits above for this entry. Leave empty to keep using mode-based limits.
data_description.max_timetable_chunks: Hard cap on Timetables API calls per refresh (each call = 60 minutes). Default 3. Lower this to protect your monthly quota.
data_description.update_condition: Optional Jinja template; fetch only when it renders to 'true' (e.g. when someone is home). Skipped updates save quota.
data_description.night_gap_end_train: Last service hour before the nightly gap (e.g. 2 = 02:00). Skips extra API calls during the gap when fetching extended time windows.
data_description.night_gap_start_train: Hour when service resumes after the gap (e.g. 4 = 04:00). Must be greater than the dead zone start hour.

resrobot.title: Resrobot Travel Search
resrobot.description: Configure origin and destination for Resrobot trips.

data.max_trip_duration: Maximum Trip Duration (minutes, leave empty for no limit)

data_description.transport_modes: Leave empty to include all modes. Note: if set, walk and transfer legs will be excluded from results.
data_description.include_platform: When enabled, each public-transport leg is matched against the Timetable Realtime API to resolve the departure platform. Requires a configured departure or arrival sensor. One extra API call per unique origin stop is made on each refresh.
